title: Wheat Flour Prices in Pakistan Rise 173% Since 2020
excerpt: Wheat flour prices in Pakistan have surged by 173% since January 2020, outpacing both cooking oil and petrol increases.
body_html:
Wheat flour prices in Pakistan have experienced a significant increase, jumping by 173% since January 2020.

According to the available data, the price growth of wheat flour has outpaced other essential commodities, climbing faster than both cooking oil and petrol during the same timeframe.
